title: Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 25.7% After Securing Oracle AI Data Center Power Deal - Has The Bull Case Changed?

summary: In late April 2026, Bloom Energy Corporation reported first-quarter revenue of US$751.05 million and net income of US$70.65 million, and raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of US$3.40 billion to US$3.80 billion.
summary_zh: 2026年4月下旬，布鲁姆能源公司公布第一季度营收为7.5105亿美元，净利润为7065万美元，并将2026年全年营收指引上调至34.0亿美元至38.0亿美元。
